name: ChatGPT
tagline: A flexible assistant for research, drafting, analysis, and everyday problem solving.
best_for: People who want one general-purpose AI workspace for several kinds of work.
pricing: Free tier available; paid plans and limits vary by region.
strengths: Handles text, images, files, and voice in one workspace
Useful for planning, drafting, and analysis
Large ecosystem of integrations and custom workflows
limits: General tools can be slower than task-specific software

name: Claude
tagline: A writing and reasoning assistant known for careful long-form responses.
best_for: Writers, researchers, and teams working with long documents or nuanced instructions.
pricing: Free tier available; paid plans vary.
strengths: Good for structured analysis and editing
limits: Product availability can vary by region

name: Gemini
tagline: Google-connected assistant for research, productivity, and multimodal tasks.
best_for: People already using Google Workspace, Search, YouTube, or Android.
pricing: Free tier available; premium plans vary.
limits: Best features may require a paid plan
Workspace controls vary by account type
Some features launch region by region

name: Perplexity
tagline: Answer engine that combines web research with source-linked responses.
best_for: Quick research where citations and source links matter.
pricing: Free tier available; Pro plans vary.
strengths: Good for current topics and comparisons
limits: Not a replacement for primary research
Complex analysis may need another tool

name: Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Microsoft-connected assistant for web research and everyday productivity.
best_for: Microsoft 365 users who want AI close to documents, email, and meetings.
pricing: Free tier available; Microsoft 365 Copilot is sold separately.
limits: Capabilities differ between free and paid versions
Enterprise rollout can require admin setup
Not every Microsoft feature supports every language

name: Midjourney
tagline: High-quality image generation with a strong visual style and active community.
best_for: Designers, concept artists, and creators who need polished visual exploration.
pricing: Paid subscription required; plan limits vary.
limits: Commercial terms should be checked for each plan

name: Adobe Firefly
tagline: Adobe creative AI for image generation, editing, and design workflows.
best_for: Adobe users who want generative features inside familiar creative tools.
pricing: Free credits available; paid plans vary.
strengths: Useful for editing and generative fill
limits: Best value is inside Adobe workflows
Not the cheapest standalone image option

name: Leonardo AI
tagline: Image generation and editing platform with models for game, product, and concept art.
best_for: Creators who want more control over models, styles, and production assets.
pricing: Free daily credits; paid plans available.
strengths: Useful for game and product concepts
limits: Interface can feel dense for beginners

name: Ideogram
tagline: Image generator with strong text rendering for posters, logos, and social graphics.
best_for: Quick visual concepts that need readable text inside the image.
pricing: Free tier available; paid plans vary.

name: Canva Magic Studio
tagline: AI-assisted design tools inside Canva for presentations, social posts, and marketing assets.
best_for: Small teams that need fast, brand-consistent visual production.
pricing: Free tier available; Pro features vary.
limits: Advanced AI features may require Pro
Less control than specialist design tools

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI coding assistant integrated across popular editors and GitHub workflows.
best_for: Developers who want inline code suggestions and help inside an existing editor.
pricing: Free plan may be available; paid plans vary.
limits: Quality varies by language and project

name: Cursor
tagline: AI-first code editor for understanding, editing, and navigating larger codebases.
best_for: Developers who want an editor built around AI-assisted changes.
pricing: Free tier available; paid plans vary.
limits: Advanced models and usage may cost more
Not a substitute for engineering judgment

name: Windsurf
tagline: AI development environment focused on agentic coding and project-level changes.
best_for: Developers experimenting with multi-step AI coding agents.
pricing: Free tier available; paid plans vary.
limits: Workflow may feel different from a standard editor

name: Replit
tagline: Browser-based development environment with AI help, hosting, and collaboration.
best_for: Beginners and small teams that want to build and deploy from a browser.
pricing: Free tier available; paid plans vary.
limits: Less control than a custom local setup

name: CodeRabbit
tagline: AI code review assistant that comments on pull requests and highlights risks.
best_for: Teams that want an automated first pass before human code review.
pricing: Free tier for open source or small usage; paid plans vary.
limits: Not a replacement for human review
